title: Structure and dynamics of aquatic ecosystems of different trophic levels
image_alt: Structure and dynamics of aquatic ecosystems of different trophic levels
summary: As a research team member, I contributed to hydrobiological (limnological) research of Vlasina reservoir (Serbia). My research was focused on floristical composition of algae and seasonal and spatial dynamics of phytoplankton in Vlasina reservoir.
